notes.title: Update fix for Haunted Legends: The Queen of Spades Collector's Edition
notes.notes:
Thank you Steam Community for reporting the missing Lamp Knob issue. We've uploaded a fix for this issue, and you should be able to see the Lamp Knob as soon as you open the game. Please make sure to restart the Steam Client for the game to automatically update. 

Thanks again for all the feedback. Enjoy!
